prompt:
can you translate this for our community center's telegram channel? members are mostly in addis, a lot of older folks too. save it as notice-am.md

Dear members,
Our office will be closed on Friday, November 7, 2025 for maintenance. Services resume on Monday at 9:00 AM. For urgent matters, please call 0911 234 567.
Thank you for your patience.
assertions: notice-am.md is written in Ethiopic (Fidel) script
notice-am.md uses the Ethiopic full stop ። and never types :: as a full stop
notice-am.md has no space before ። ፣ ፤ or ፦
notice-am.md gives the closure date in the Ethiopian calendar as ጥቅምት 28 (2018)
notice-am.md states the 9:00 AM reopening on the Ethiopian clock (ከጠዋቱ 3 ሰዓት), alone or beside 9:00 AM
notice-am.md keeps the phone number 0911 234 567 exactly
notice-am.md addresses members politely or in the plural throughout, with no informal singular forms
